title: Silver Soars Again. Why the Rally May Not Last.
text: Silver futures  were on course to close with a gain of 15% shortly after noon on Tuesday, while gold contracts were up 6.5%.  Silver’s standout performance comes after two hard days for the metal.  It matters because Matt Bauer, a commodity strategist at Ned Davis Research, has identified four prior instances where silver has broken such a streak with a 20% correction following an all-time high.
